related_questions.question: Can my dog be a carrier of COVID?
related_questions.snippet: The virus that causes COVID-19 can spread from people to animals during close contact. Pets worldwide, including cats and dogs, have been infected with the virus that causes COVID-19, mostly after close contact with people with COVID-19. The risk of pets spreading COVID-19 to people is low.

list.snippet: Pets can be a source of comfort and support when you're feeling unwell, and snuggling with them can help reduce stress and anxiety.

list.snippet: While cuddling is generally safe, if your dog seems uncomfortable or uninterested in cuddling, respect their boundaries and give them space.
